forum.title: STM32CubeMX Windows Download Problem
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @alw

Let's try to delete the existing stm32cubemx-win-v6-17-0.zip file and any CubeMX-related temporary or cache files, then download the installer again directly from [the official ST website](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html) using a stable connection; if possible, try a different browser or network. Also check whether antivirus, proxy, VPN, or corporate security tools are modifying the download. Once you have a clean file, verify that it extracts correctly and then run the installer as administrator.

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
I downloaded stm32cubemx-win-v6-17-0.zip on Windows 11 direct from the ST web page:

[STM32CubeMX | Software - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

Downloaded file size 676,525 MB

But it does not uncompress and install, all I get is a kind of ghost window that tries to launch but then aborts.

Any ideas please?

Kind regards,

Al
